xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5478: docs: CLI reference completeness

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only change across 11 Mintlify files in three doc directories (cli/, features/, configuration/) plus docs.json. Three new CLI pages and one extended page run as four independent per-file chains; nav, cross-links and validation depend on the pages existing, so splitting into sibling issues would ship orphaned pages or dead links.

narratives.Problem: The CLI Reference covers about half of pan's 97 top-level verbs. The 2026-11-17 feature inventory (section 1.12) lists 32 verbs no cli/*.mdx page covers, including plan, task, show, handoff, fork, conv, memory, flywheel, orders, reload, shutdown and cost; the existing pan restart section contradicts current help (ports 3010, no hold/approve).
narratives.Proposal: Add cli/conversation-commands.mdx, cli/pipeline-commands.mdx and cli/memory-commands.mdx, extend cli/core-commands.mdx (rewrite pan restart; add reload, shutdown, update, cost, models, integrate, tts, backup, restore), add the pages to docs.json and cli/overview.mdx, and link them from five related pages. Each verb gets a reference section built from pan <verb> --help and source, per the PRD template; concepts stay on owning feature pages, which the sections link. Mechanical checks prove every subcommand is listed, no flag is invented, no dashes, and Mintlify validates.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes under src/, scripts/, tests/, packages/ or apps/; no changelog.d entry
- No fix to stale CLI help text (for example pan scope's 'Move xBRIEF to proposed/'); docs describe the code
- No accuracy rewrite of pan up, pan down, pan health or other untouched sections of existing CLI pages (PAN-5501 owns them)
- No CLI sections for artifacts (PAN-5482 G21), init, monitor, inbox, reset-session, sync-main, destroy, test, release, rollout, compliance, registry, ohmypi-auth, caveman-compress, dev or projects
- No feature pages for the issue pipeline, Flywheel, costs, voice or operating Overdeck (PAN-5468, PAN-5470, PAN-5475, PAN-5481, PAN-5482)
- No moving or deleting sections on other pages; no documentation of hidden options such as pan shutdown --finish
- No screenshots
- No mint validate --fix and no mint@latest

autoDecisions.summary: Cover the issue's named verbs plus short sections for the eight other row-1.12 verbs (scope, staffing, context, knowledge, docs, briefing, tts, backup) and restore and unarchive-conversation as halves of documented verbs; leave artifacts and 15 other uncovered verbs as non-goals
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names pages and verbs explicitly and says to read help for every verb in the 1.12 CLI row; a short section on the nearest page closes the row without inventing pages. artifacts must first be confirmed user-facing by PAN-5482 G21.

autoDecisions.summary: Full subcommand table plus options only for named subcommands of pan conv and pan memory (D-4)
autoDecisions.rationale: Both verbs have 20+ subcommands; a fixed rule makes the diff deterministic and keeps the page readable while the completeness check still lists every subcommand.

autoDecisions.summary: Short entries plus links for tell, share and open, which already have pages (D-5)
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids duplicating or moving content that other issues (PAN-5501) own while still making the CLI reference complete.

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite only the pan restart section of cli/core-commands.mdx; leave up, down and health to PAN-5501 (D-9)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for restart hold additions and the existing section contradicts help; the rest of the page belongs to the accuracy audit.

autoDecisions.summary: Link unlanded sibling pages only if the .mdx file exists after sync-main, else a stand-in (D-7)
autoDecisions.rationale: mint broken-links fails on links to missing pages; sibling issues PAN-5468/5470/5475/5481 may land in either order.

autoDecisions.summary: Code wins over stale help text; ignored, deprecated and refused flags are documented with their status (D-6)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires every claim to match current code; features/planning.mdx already set this precedent for pan scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove all dashes from the three new pages, cli/core-commands.mdx and cli/overview.mdx; only added lines elsewhere (D-8)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires removing dashes from bodies we edit; these five files are substantially edited, while cross-link pages get one line each and their other lines belong to their own issues.

autoDecisions.summary: One xBRIEF with four parallel per-file chains instead of sibling issues (D-11)
autoDecisions.rationale: The pages are independent but nav, overview, cross-links and validation need all of them; one plan keeps them consistent.
